ui:WORLD.text.stood: When you stand up at the end of the prologue and the village begins.
ui:WORLD.text.berries: When the first settler arrives (right after the line above).
ui:WORLD.text.lights: Once, when you have 10 settlers and your home is 40% lit.
ui:WORLD.text.great: Once, when your home is 45% lit.
ui:WORLD.text.hungry: Once, the first time food runs out while you have settlers.
ui:WORLD.text.map: When your home is fully lit and the home beacon is built: the moment the map opens.
ui:WORLD.text.stage: Each time a stage of a village project is finished.
ui:WORLD.text.built: When a village project is finished.
ui:WORLD.text.haulBack: When a project is finished, nothing else is planned, and the haulers go back to the jobs they came from.
ui:WORLD.text.haulIdle: When a project is finished, nothing else is planned, and the haulers have no job to go back to.
ui:WORLD.text.queued: When you buy a card that starts a project while another project is still being built.
ui:WORLD.text.fullWait: Once, when your home is fully lit but the home beacon isn't built yet.
ui:WORLD.text.full: Once, when your home is fully lit.
ui:MT.scholars: When the map opens, if you have storytellers (or know storytelling).
ui:MT.restored: Each time a place is called back.
ui:MT.region: When the last place of a region is called back (when relics don't ring; not used now).
ui:MT.resonate: When the last place of a region is called back.
ui:MT.copper: When the copper place is called back.
ui:MT.surge: When a place is called back while you're playing: its land's work goes faster for a while.
ui:MT.glow: When a glowstone is made (glowstones are cut; not seen now).
ui:MT.ruinFound: When the place with the broken tower is called back.
ui:MT.ruinStart: When you start repairing the broken tower.
key:p.msg.start: The very first line of a new game.
key:p.msg.away: In the prologue, when you come back after time away and can already see numbers.
key:p.msg.awayVague: In the prologue, when you come back after time away before you can see numbers.
key:sn.msg.seen: Once, when your home is 25% lit: the first snail.
key:w.msg.maxed: When a building line reaches its last level.
key:w.msg.ideas: Once, the first time you have an idea.
key:w.msg.feast: Each time you hold a feast.
key:w.msg.stoked: Once, the first time you stoke the fire.
key:w.msg.learned: Each time you buy an idea or research card.
key:p.msg.awaycap: When you come back after longer than your time-away limit.
key:a.log.bg: When the game was running in a background tab for 5 minutes or more.
key:m.msg.settler: The first time a settler arrives in the map phase.
